{"pattern_id": "P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "decision": "APPLY", "rationale": "The workflow uses ruby/setup-ruby with bundler-cache: true, but the pattern requires an explicit actions/cache@v4 step keyed by runner OS and lockfile for each matrix variant. Adding narrow cache steps before setup-ruby preserves all install/test commands and required checks while implementing the dependency_cache mechanism.", "workflow_yaml": "'on':
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Cache bundler dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: vendor/bundle
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-ruby-3.4-bundler-${{ hashFiles('Gemfile.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-ruby-3.4-bundler-

    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: "3.4"
        bundler-cache: true

    - name: Lint
      run: bundle exec rake rubocop

  test:
    name: Test Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby }} on ActiveModel ${{ matrix.activemodel }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        ruby: ["3.4"]
        activemodel: ["8.1"]
        include:
          - activemodel: "8.0"
            ruby: "3.4"
          - activemodel: "7.2"
            ruby: "3.3"
          - activemodel: "7.1"
            ruby: "3.3"
          - activemodel: "7.0"
            ruby: "3.2"
          - activemodel: "6.1"
            ruby: "3.1"
          - activemodel: "6.0"
            ruby: "3.0"
          - activemodel: "5.2"
            ruby: "2.7"

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      BUNDLE_GEMFILE: gemfiles/rails-${{ matrix.activemodel }}.gemfile

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Install Prerequisites
      run: sudo apt install libsqlite3-dev

    - name: Cache bundler dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: vendor/bundle
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-ruby-${{ matrix.ruby }}-bundler-${{ hashFiles(format('gemfiles/rails-{0}.gemfile.lock', matrix.activemodel)) }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-ruby-${{ matrix.ruby }}-bundler-

    - name: Set up Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby }}
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
        bundler-cache: true

    - name: Test
      run: bundle exec rake spec
"}
